messages.text:
The core smoke set is byte-identical now.

I’m expanding into file and converter scenarios next, especially `open`, `from json/csv`, and record/list shaping where small type coercion differences can sneak in.

commands.commandLine:
"C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command "@'
import subprocess, pathlib, os, tempfile, json
root=pathlib.Path.cwd(); nu=pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip(); exe=str((root/'executable.cmd').resolve())
d=(root/'tmp_probe2'); d.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(d/'a.txt').write_text('hello', encoding='utf-8')
(d/'data.json').write_text('{\"a\":1,\"b\":[2,3]}', encoding='utf-8')
(d/'data.csv').write_text('name,age\\nann,3\\nbob,4\\n', encoding='utf-8')
cases=[
 ['-c','open tmp_probe2/a.txt'], ['-c','open tmp_probe2/a.txt --raw'], ['-c','open tmp_probe2/data.json | get b.1'],
 ['-c','open tmp_probe2/data.csv | get age | math sum'], ['-c','\"{\\\\\"a\\\\\":1,\\\\\"b\\\\\":[2,3]}\" | from json | get b.0'],
 ['-c','\"name,age\\nann,3\\nbob,4\\n\" | from csv | get age | math sum'], ['-c','[3 1 2] | sort'], ['-c','[3 1 2] | reverse'],
 ['-c','[1 2 3] | skip 1'], ['-c','[1 2 3] | take 2'], ['-c','[1 2 3] | where "'$it > 1'"'],
 ['-c','[[name age]; [ann 3] [bob 4]] | select name'], ['-c','[[name age]; [ann 3] [bob 4]] | sort-by age | reverse | get name.0'],
 ['-c','[1 2] | str join \"\"'], ['-c','[a b c] | str join \",\"'], ['-c','1 == 1'], ['-c','1 "'!= 2'"'], ['-c','2 >= 1'],
]
fail=0
for args in cases:
 r=subprocess.run([nu]+args,capture_output=True,cwd=root)
 p=subprocess.run([exe]+args,capture_output=True,cwd=root)
 if (r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)"'!=(p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr):
  fail+=1; print('"'DIFF',args); print('ref',r.returncode,repr(r.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace')),repr(r.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace')[:250])); print('py ',p.returncode,repr(p.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace')),repr(p.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace')[:250]))
print('fails',fail)
'@ | python -"
